summary: MakeMyTrip Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an earnings release for fiscal Q1 2027 (quarter ended June 30, 2026). The release reports unaudited IFRS and non-IFRS financial results, including gross bookings of $2,854.7 million, revenue of $285.6 million, profit of $9.1 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $55.5 million. No special-situation transaction, acquisition, divestiture, tender, or strategic action is described. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure incorporated by reference into an existing resale shelf registration statement. The filing does not indicate any corporate event requiring special-situations classification.
